obj_desc:
Ganesha is one of the most revered deities in Hinduism, referred to as the "Destroyer of Obstacles" and the "Master of Intellect". Inspired by this deity and the growing importance of Information Security in modern times, students from ICMC-USP decided to create an extracurricular group in this field.

Through the study and development of techniques and algorithms focused on computer systems and network security, the group aims to provide members with a facilitated learning and knowledge-sharing experience.

Furthermore, the group seeks to integrate and interact with groups outside the University, as well as disseminate its acquired experiences and knowledge to the broader community through public activities, short courses, and lectures.
area_cripto_desc: Mathematical algorithms to ensure data secrecy and integrity.
area_redes_desc: Traffic and protocol analysis to identify vulnerabilities and secure connections.
area_web_desc: Identification and remediation of vulnerabilities in websites, APIs, and servers.
area_eng_desc: Disassembling binaries to understand the inner workings of software.
area_hw_desc: Exploring circuits and firmware to test the physical security of devices.
ctf_desc: We actively participate in national and international competitions, putting our knowledge to the test in real and challenging scenarios.
ping_titulo: I want to become a Member!
ping_desc: The only requirement is to participate in our Ping (Admission Process), which takes place in the first semester.
usp_desc: The University of São Paulo (USP), founded in 1934, is the largest and most prestigious public university in Brazil and a benchmark in Ibero-America. Ranked among the top 100 global institutions in reputation, USP engages in teaching, research, and extension across all fields of knowledge. It counts around 90,000 students across 11 campuses in the state of São Paulo.
icmc_desc: The Institute of Mathematics and Computer Sciences (ICMC) at USP is a national and international benchmark in Computer Science, Mathematics, and Statistics. Located on the São Carlos campus, the institute focuses on undergraduate and graduate education, knowledge generation, and technological innovation.
